selection_rules.human: Choose either one homeland plus one profession, or one alternate path; do not combine an alternate path with a homeland or profession.
selection_rules.other_races: Use the listed race-specific options when present.
selection_rules.restricted_races: Require VP; availability may be limited by staff.
selection_rules.starting_skills: Each grant is free at the listed level. Resolve one choice from each starting_skills.choices group; a grant condition refers to skills granted by the chosen homeland.
selection_rules.racial_purchases: Racial purchases are separate from regular skills; each costs the listed CP and is limited to max_purchases.

racial_purchases.name: Racial Resist: Delusions / Hallucinations / Intoxication
racial_purchases.description: Each purchase grants one daily resist that can cover Delusions, Hallucinations, or Intoxication. The third resist is usable once per combat.
